featured_reviews.name: Shubhangi Sood
featured_reviews.review_text: I absolutely adore the book collection here and have shopped for almost 20 books in the past few months. As a regular book thrifter and collector, I have shopped for several stores, but I have to say their collection is the most unique - it’s a wonderful blend of classics, contemporary literature, and translated fiction. So many books that I added to my wishlist, I end up finding them here for a fraction of cost. It’s also lovely to receive the cute and thoughtful handwritten thoughts that Shamim writes plus the bookmarks are always so exquisite. I really appreciate how flexible he is with payments and deliveries. Hope I can visit the store in person sometime soon! Definitely a paradise for book lovers!

featured_reviews.name: Ankita Pattanaik
featured_reviews.review_text: They do have an online shop and I have recently purchased some books from them. If you're into pre-loved books then please go for it. It's an experience to buy such books in which the previous owner's essence keeps lingering like a legacy.

description: UNSURE COMICS is a Mumbai-based Comic Book Company. Our stories are based on Indian characters, they explore the Indian culture, its places, religion and more. The genres that we cover are Action, Adventure, Sci-Fi, and Humor. We focus on the complicated relationships people share and the emotional bond they make on this wonderful journey called life.

featured_reviews.name: PREM THORAT
featured_reviews.review_text: This comic is pure entertainment! The twin rivalry theme is executed ⚫brilliantly. Jovan and Kimaya are well-developed characters with great dynamics. The artwork is stunning, and the action sequences are well-paced. I found myself laughing and rooting for both of them. The writing is fresh, and the humor lands perfectly. It's a great blend of action, adventure, and sibling chaos. Looking forward to what happens next!

featured_reviews.name: Aditya Kathurojigari
featured_reviews.review_text: I got to know about these comics by Unsure Comics, and they are just awesome! The way they portray plants in their comics is unique and refreshing. Moreover, their comics are super easy to relate to, and they're also pretty funny! But the best part is the incredible artwork it's worth every penny and every second spent reading. You should check them out!

featured_reviews.name: Vinayak Lokhande
featured_reviews.review_text: Unsure Comic Company delivers a delightful blend of humor, heart, and nostalgia in every issue. With vibrant artwork and engaging storytelling, they capture the essence of friendship in each panel. The characters are relatable and endearing, drawing readers into their adventures with every turn of the page. Whether you're a longtime fan or new to the world of comics, Unsure Comic Company is sure to leave you smiling.

They even replace the books if there is any problem after purchase 👍🏻

featured_reviews.name: brendan fernandes
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a very disappointing experience at Shanti Book Store. When I went to buy books, they offered used books, claiming they were “unused,” and sold them at a discounted price. Later, when I took my daughter’s old books to sell, they offered me only ₹100. After that, I noticed the same books were being sold to other parents at a much higher price (around half of the MRP).
This feels unfair and misleading. I request that other parents be careful while buying or selling books here. The old man who handles it is a very cheap beggar. When I said that I am taking my old books back then he took out some books giving them back to me and says this is no longer in use school has stopped this edition and u feel that it is not in use. This is all about a scam. Parents be alert.

featured_reviews.name: Hemal Chheda
featured_reviews.review_text:
A BIG AVOID..  Readers please note all those who have given 5 stars are either owners/staff themselves or their relatives...
1. Very rude and arrogant owner and his son..
2. They will initially offer big discounts on entire sets and then pretend that some of the books(often the most expensive of the sets)  are out of stock. when you go to buy these books they wont offer discounts.
They are just surviving because of their closeness with various school authorities.
Selling books for knowledge is a noble job but this money hungry people have made it a shameful business.
Wouldnt have given even 1 star if it was not mandatory by google to post a review...

featured_reviews.review_text:
Update as on Dec'22:
Great collection of latest novels and educational books too!!

One of the oldest book store in chembur now run by the 3rd generation. You will get all kinds of books here.. bestsellers, kids books, craft and creativity.. name it and u get it.

I have been visiting the store of late to buy books for my toddlers and their friends.. they have an amazing collection of books for the youngest age group of young readers too !!

Highly impressive collection and the owner actually gives u suggestions which are just right for u !!! A must visit store.

featured_reviews.name: Sadhan Deb
featured_reviews.review_text: It is a popular bookstore in chembur opposite Natraj theatre. They keep a variety of books. You can in fact order off-the-shelf academic books, and the proprietor would get it for you in a week or two. The proprietor has good knowledge in helping you select books for a gift, especially for children.

featured_reviews.name: Sriniwas Ghate
featured_reviews.review_text: It is a very nice book store. Most of the English classics are available here.They have a good collection of children's books too. Besides that they are known for providing textbooks of various competitive exams. You can place your order with them and within few days they will provide you with book of almost any examination. As far as the prices are concerned, they sell on MRP which is a lot more than some online marketplaces. They also have a good second hand book collection. Overall I would say it is a must visit place for any booklover especially in a place like Chembur!

featured_reviews.name: Shekhar Sherikar
featured_reviews.review_text: Been in business for a very long time, this bookstore is ideal if you are looking for useful books such as school text books, engineering text books, management text books, etc. Has a great collection of books for kids. Has a great collection of fiction books as well, but where it shines is the useful books. The proprietor is polite, helpful and knows how to treat customers well. Highly recommended.

featured_reviews.name: Rocky Jagtiani
featured_reviews.review_text: Yes, the bookstore is very good. It has too many books ranging from the lowest to the highest level. They have even made their shop air conditioned now which is a good thing. The only problem is that you won't be able to stand and read books here for many hours as many book worms do. The shop is a bit cramped up but that won't matter if you just wanna buy a book.

featured_reviews.name: Sundarraj Kaushik
featured_reviews.review_text:
A good place to buy both academic and general books. Lots of books for kids.
Many fiction books are available too. Academic books seem to be limited to state board and CBSE.
Not many options for ICSE.
They also have a stock of second hand books.
The staff is friendly and well informed.
You can return most of the books after the academic year and get back half of the price if you maintain it in good shape.

featured_reviews.name: deeksha garg
featured_reviews.review_text:
A great book store hidden inside shivalaya market in Chembur. I went there on behalf of my husband to buy a book for a secret Santa gift. I'm not a fan of books but I liked the place, I felt like exploring the books.
Nice place and they're very polite and helpful in selecting books.
